neighbours.label: Farm field operations: function and process words in text about tillage, planting, fertilizing and irrigating crop fields, vs the same sentence frames about non-farm work
fire: Many growers now seed soybeans with no-till drills to keep residue on the soil.
Before planting, the crew disked the field twice to break up the clods.
Center-pivot irrigation lets the farm water each quarter section evenly.
Last spring the farmer spread manure on the cornfield using a new spreader.
Strip tillage leaves the rows between the crop untouched to limit erosion.
The co-op sells anhydrous ammonia that farmers inject into the soil before planting.
Yield monitors on the combine show which parts of the field produce the most grain.
Cover crops planted after harvest keep the field from washing away in winter.
quiet: Many bakers now mix dough with spiral mixers to keep the crumb soft.
Before painting, the crew sanded the walls twice to smooth out the cracks.
Central air conditioning lets the office cool each floor evenly.
Last spring the landlord spread gravel on the driveway using a new rake.
Masking tape leaves the trim between the panels untouched to avoid smudges.
The store sells cleaning solution that janitors spray onto the floor before mopping.
Sensors on the forklift show which parts of the warehouse store the most boxes.
Curtains hung after the move keep the room from getting cold in winter.
